rv.q: For four decades, Jesse Malin was the music mayor of New York’s East Village. Beginning in the early ‘80s with his teenaged hardcore band Heart Attack through his years with the rock band D-Generation, his solo career and his Coney Island High nightclub, he was never a superstar but was a well-known, well-connected and tireless booster for the...
Silver Manhattan is a smart business move, documentation of Malin's hard-fought journey, and a very solid rock set.
This is Holy water for your soul!
It's a powerful story from a guy who always loved the music, never went the drugs-and-booze route, and has an unquenchable fighting spirit.
Silver Manhattan may strike some musical-theater aficionados as static ... But this is a powerful work that belongs to a lineage of serious, meritorious rock musicals...

cn.t: Critics praise this intimate rock memoir as a deeply moving theatrical experience, with Jesse Malin delivering powerful performances that blend music and storytelling in the perfectly suited downtown Bowery Palace venue.
